notes:
Lead source: inbound signup (self-serve free tier). Replicated user flow: created dev key, ran 3 test calls. Early discovery call 2026-03-04.

Meeting highlights:
- Product: small support SaaS, 120 employees, US HQ. Building AI-first helpdesk assistant + knowledge search.
- Primary ask: clear answers on data privacy & retention for Hosted API. Team worried their end-users' messages (prompts) might be persisted by Redwood for training/analytics.
- Questions asked repeatedly: 'Do you store prompts?', 'How long are logs kept?', 'Can we opt users out of retention?', 'Is there a way to disable prompt storage per API key?', 'Where are logs stored (region)?'
- Cost sensitivity: low-middle (won't pay for Dedicated initially). Willing to pay modest hosted fees if privacy guarantees are explicit.

Technical details / constraints noted:
- Main workload: real-time chat (support agent) with short sequences (avg 150 tokens) — latency SLO ~250ms P50, P95 < 600ms.
- Throughput: bursty — peak 50 concurrent sessions, otherwise low.
- Wants per-customer data residency (US-only) if possible for logs/retention.
- Expectation: hosted_api + simple console to toggle 'no retention' for specific API keys or projects.

Requested deliverables from AE/SE:
- Short one-pager that spells out: what is logged (request metadata, full prompt text, completions, debug traces), default retention windows for each (e.g., 30d, 90d), where PII appears in logs, options to opt-out or redact.
- Example curl + header pattern to send 'do-not-retain: true' on requests and service behavior.
- Sample DPA language for hosted API and an addendum for no-log option.

Quotes / paraphrase from customer:
- 'We need to tell our customers exactly what happens to their messages — can't leave it vague.'
- 'If we can't switch off prompt storage for specific customers, we may have to look at self-hosting in 6–12 months.'

Internal timeline / activities:
- 2026-02-25: inbound signup, auto-onboarded, created sandbox API key.
- 2026-03-01: automated usage pattern flagged small traffic; assigned AE.
- 2026-03-04: discovery call (recorded, ff-20260304-89).
- 2026-03-05: SE follow-up email with perf numbers and link to hosted pricing. (gmail thread: thread/CA1234ADf3qwe)
- 2026-03-09: legal sent preliminary DPA ask via drive/tidepool-dpa-draft.docx; opened support ticket SUP-1245 re: retention settings.

Suggested risk/opportunity notes:
- High likelihood to convert to paid hosted account if we provide a simple no-retention toggle and DPA excerpt. Low near-term ARR but good product-led expansion potential.
- Risk: if we are vague or require enterprise contract for opt-out, they'll evaluate competitors or move to open-source stack.

- SE to draft short technical note: 'how hosted retention works' and sample code to redact PII client-side.
